name: Raavasta Observer

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Cloak and Claw
traits.details: The raavasta observer deals an extra 2d6 damage against a target when it makes an attack while it has total concealment.

hit.description: damage, and the target is blinded (save ends)
psychic damage, and the target slides 5 squares and grants combat advantage to the raavasta observer until the end of the target's next turn

effect.description: The raavasta observer can alter its physical form to take on the appearance of any Medium humanoid, including a unique individual.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.trigger: when an enemy hits the raavasta observer

effect.description: The raavasta observer shifts 3 squares and is invisible until the end of its next turn or until it attacks.
